Settings for ensemble FABIA

Source: R/fabia_ensemble.R
fabia_ensemble_control.Rd

Collects the settings of the ensemble FABIA procedure, used by fabia_ensemble() and by run_factor_pipeline(methods = "FABIA_ENS").

Usage

fabia_ensemble_control(
  runs = 30,
  sample_fraction = 1,
  similarity = 0.5,
  min_reliability = 0.5,
  membership = 0.5,
  thresZ = 0.5,
  thresL = NULL
)

Arguments

runs

Number of FABIA runs (default 30). The book used 100.

sample_fraction

Share of samples used in each run. 1 (default) reruns FABIA on all samples with a different seed; a value below 1 draws a random subsample without replacement for each run.

similarity

Jaccard similarity at which the bicluster tree is cut (default 0.5: biclusters in the same group share at least half of their row-column combinations).

min_reliability

Minimum reliability (share of runs in which a group of biclusters was found) for a group to be kept (default 0.5).

membership

Share of a group's biclusters a feature or sample must belong to, to be part of the robust bicluster. 1 gives the core (intersection) bicluster, a small value such as 0.01 the "super" (union) bicluster, and 0.2 the threshold of the biclust package. Default 0.5.

thresZ, thresL

Thresholds on factor scores and loadings used to turn each FABIA factor into a bicluster; passed to fabia::extractBic() (defaults 0.5 and NULL, i.e. FABIA's own choice).

Value

A named list.

References

Khamiakova T, Kaiser S, Shkedy Z (2016). Ensemble methods and robust solutions. In Kasim A, Shkedy Z, Kaiser S, Hochreiter S, Talloen W (eds), Applied Biclustering Methods for Big and High-Dimensional Data Using R, Chapter 10. Chapman and Hall/CRC.

Examples

fabia_ensemble_control(runs = 50, sample_fraction = 0.8)
#> $runs
#> [1] 50
#> 
#> $sample_fraction
#> [1] 0.8
#> 
#> $similarity
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> $min_reliability
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> $membership
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> $thresZ
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> $thresL
#> NULL
#>
